note: `:refer` names resolve unqualified calls through the refer table (U1-class finding, the elixir ELXD17 sibling): `(:require [lib :refer [name]])` CONFIRMS the target, so the call edge names `lib/name` instead of the bare dangling identity. Resolution runs POST-WALK so a LOCAL def of the same name wins (Clojure's ns mapping — `parse-edn` is defn'd in-file, so both its call sites keep the bare local identity and the qualified form is forbidden). Covers the three emission shapes: generic call, thread step (arity-adjusted), #() shorthand. Names are deliberately non-core — core-builtin names (`replace`, `join`, …) are suppressed before resolution and would pin nothing.
